name: local-vision
description: Describe attached images on-device with Ollama moondream (~1.7 GB).

interface.shortDescription: On-device image descriptions via Ollama (moondream, ~1.7 GB).
interface.longDescription: Describe composer attachments locally before they reach your chat model. Install Ollama, run `ollama pull moondream`, enable this plugin. Optional variables: OLLAMA_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:11434), OLLAMA_VISION_MODEL (default moondream).
defaultPrompt: Describe the UI in this image
